User.title: User
User.description: User profile containing role, growth milestones (SOL), targets, and remarks.

role.description: The system role which dictates permissions

ladderOfSuccess.description: List of achieved SOL milestones (e.g., Win, Consolidate, Discipleship)

targetToDo.description: List of active goals or tasks

remarks.description: Additional notes or follow-up actions for the member

assignedLeaderId.description: The UID of the leader managing this member

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the record was created

/users/{userId}.description: Main collection for user profiles and member records.
